name: Prism TCG
summary: Prism TCG is a free online trading card game played in the browser, with no download. Players build 100-card decks led by a Traveler Soul and battle one-on-one or at a four-player table, against other people or AI opponents. The game grew out of a live tabletop roleplaying stream: its characters, realms and stories come from those campaigns, and new cards arrive as the story unfolds on stream. Cards and packs are earned by playing and by watching, never bought. Alongside ranked and casual play, Prism includes guided lessons, a draft mode and a roguelite solo mode.
